text.arabic_uthmani: فَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا بَٰعِدْ بَيْنَ أَسْفَارِنَا وَظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ وَمَزَّقْنَٰهُمْ كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍۢ شَكُورٍۢ

words.gloss_range: result or sequence particle linking the complaint to the prior travel provision
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) makes the complaint a next beat after the arranged travel of 34:18. The particle carries prior ease into the speech scene, so the request for distance begins as a response to mercy rather than hardship.

topics.headline: complaint tied to prior ease
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the complaint is born from the prior ease in 34:18, not from an independent hardship.
topics.reason: The initial particle links the speech scene to the preceding arranged travel, carrying sequence and consequence into the complaint.

words.gloss_range: completed plural speech introducing the quoted request
words.root_gloss_range: speech, saying, and report; here selected as a completed corporate utterance

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: later reports predicate that reverses the opening speech act

words.prose: {{ar:قَالُوا۟}} ({{tr:qālū}}) turns inner dissatisfaction into a completed corporate utterance. The audience hears the request before the narrator names it self-wronging, and the speech-field reverses later when the speakers become {{ar:أَحَادِيثَ}} ({{tr:aḥādītha}}), reports about themselves, with 23:44 as a judgment-formula parallel.

topics.headline: corporate speech becomes accountable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that dissatisfaction becomes a public completed speech-act by the whole community.
topics.reason: The perfect plural verb and hidden plural subject make the quoted request a corporate act, not private mood.

topics.headline: quote heard before verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader first hears the request itself and only then receives the narrator's moral classification of it.
topics.reason: The direct quotation precedes the self-wronging clause, so the wrong is displayed before it is labeled.

topics.headline: speakers become narrated material
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a reversal: those who produced speech are later turned into reports carried by others.
topics.reason: The local movement from speech to reports is supported by the later result predicate and by the recurrence of the making-into-reports formula in 23:44.

words.gloss_range: vocative possessive address to the sustaining Lord inside the quoted request
words.root_gloss_range: lordship, nurture, ordering, and ownership; here invoked as direct address
words.prose: {{ar:رَبَّنَا}} ({{tr:rabbanā}}) establishes dependence before the command. The possessive vocative addresses the sustaining Lord while asking that measured provision be altered, making the plea internally tense against 34:18 and the gratitude frame of 34:15. Variant readings can shift the line toward assertion, but the local canonical form keeps direct address and request exposed.

topics.headline: dependent address before command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the speakers acknowledge dependence before asking for the arrangement to be altered.
topics.reason: The accusative vocative and possessive suffix make the Lord the direct addressee and make the speakers' dependence explicit.

topics.headline: lordship invoked against provision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the tension of invoking the sustaining Lord while asking for distance from a measured provision.
topics.reason: The local address stands against the prior measured travel in 34:18 and the gratitude frame around 34:15.

topics.headline: variant shifts request toward assertion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that variant case and verbing can shift agency, while the canonical wording keeps direct address and request in view.
topics.reason: The nominative variant can recast the clause, but the aligned local form is vocative accusative with an imperative.

words.gloss_range: imperative request to widen the interval-field between journeys
words.root_gloss_range: distance, remoteness, exclusion, and loss; here locally narrowed to requested spacing
words.prose: {{ar:بَٰعِدْ}} ({{tr:bāʿid}}) is the command that targets the interval-field, not a simple travel object. The word asks for the prior nearness to become distance, so desired spacing returns as exposure between safe stops, rupture, and later remoteness in 34:52-53. Variant forms expose stronger intensity or different agency, while the canonical imperative keeps the human demand visible.

topics.headline: command targets the interval-field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the request is not simply for travel, but for widened spacing between journey legs.
topics.reason: The imperative governs the following interval phrase, making relational spacing the target of the command.

topics.headline: distance desired before punishment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the moral irony that distance is first requested as a preference before it returns as exposure between safe stops and loss.
topics.reason: The root field supports remoteness and exclusion, while the local command asks to widen what had been measured ease.

topics.headline: variants expose agency and intensity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices alternate readings that vary intensity and agency, while the canonical imperative leaves human desire grammatically exposed.
topics.reason: The variant set is valid contrast evidence, but the local aligned form remains the imperative addressed to the Lord.

topics.headline: requested spacing returns as rupture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks how requested widening comes back as unreachable distance and tearing later in the surah and clause.
topics.reason: The same distance field reappears in 34:52-53, and the local consequence answers the request with tearing.

words.gloss_range: governed relational interval after the distancing command
words.root_gloss_range: separation, interval, distinction, and clarification; here the interval sense is primary
words.prose: {{ar:بَيْنَ}} ({{tr:bayna}}) names the connective space they want stretched. Its governed interval sense is primary, but the root's distinction and clarity pressure matters because that widened gap becomes part of the final sign-field. The case variant can spotlight the interval itself, while the canonical accusative keeps it dependent on the command.

topics.headline: interval governed by the command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the fragile connective space between trips as the exact thing they ask to stretch.
topics.reason: The accusative relational term is governed by the imperative and sits between the command and the possessed journeys.

topics.headline: case variant spotlights relation-space
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that variant case can make the interval itself more topical, while the canonical accusative keeps it governed by the command.
topics.reason: The nominative variant is useful contrast, but the standard local parse is an adverbial accusative domain.

topics.headline: separation becomes readable evidence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the widened gap becomes the very field in which the closing signs are read.
topics.reason: The interval and clarity pressures of the root cohere with the final contained signs without replacing the local interval sense.

words.gloss_range: possessed plural journeys governed by the interval phrase
words.root_gloss_range: journeying, exposure, record, and disclosure; here journey remains primary while disclosure pressure survives
words.prose: {{ar:أَسْفَارِنَا}} ({{tr:asfārinā}}) makes the route system theirs in grammar: possessed, plural, and made of repeated journey legs. The local sense is journeys, yet the root's disclosure and written-record pressure survives because the request exposes their evaluation and the people later become reports.

topics.headline: their repeated journeys claimed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divinely measured mobility is grammatically claimed as their own repeated travel-system.
topics.reason: The genitive plural with the first-person suffix makes the request corporate and possessive, and the broken plural keeps repeated journey legs visible.

topics.headline: travel exposes and becomes report
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the travel noun carry exposure and written-record pressure while the local sense remains their journeys.
topics.reason: The local grammar selects journeys, but the sparse root field and the later reports allow disclosure and record pressure to survive as a controlled payoff.

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction moving out of the quote into narrator judgment
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) moves the ayah out of the quote and into narrator judgment. It binds the spoken request to self-wronging without making the verdict part of their speech or reducing the link to a bare timeline.

topics.headline: quotation exits into verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah leaving the people's speech and immediately binding it to self-wronging.
topics.reason: The conjunction resumes narration after the quote while coordinating the speech with the evaluative verb.

words.gloss_range: completed transitive self-wronging before the divine result
words.root_gloss_range: darkness, wrong, and misplacement; here moral misplacement is selected
words.prose: {{ar:ظَلَمُوٓا۟}} ({{tr:ẓalamū}}) gives the request its moral hinge. The perfect transitive verb makes the wrong completed and self-directed; the root's misplacement pressure shows them treating ordered nearness as something to remove, while the same corporate group that spoke now harms itself.

topics.headline: completed transitive self-wrong
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the request is morally reclassified as completed harm to themselves before any result is narrated.
topics.reason: The perfect transitive verb takes the following self-object and stands as the hinge before the result particle.

topics.headline: wrong as moral misplacement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the failure as misplacing a blessing, not merely making a poor travel preference.
topics.reason: The root field supports wrong as disorientation and misplacement, while the closing gratitude trait supplies the opposite response.

topics.headline: same group harms itself
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same corporate body from speech into reflexive harm.
topics.reason: The plural ending matches the speakers, and the local verb-object pair activates the known self-wronging formula, including 2:57.

words.gloss_range: their own selves as the explicit object of wronging
words.root_gloss_range: self, person, inner life, and living identity; here plural possessed selves are harmed

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: repeated plural object or possessive suffix tracking the same community

words.prose: {{ar:أَنفُسَهُمْ}} ({{tr:anfusahum}}) names the harmed object as their own plural selves. The word collapses agent and patient, and the repeated {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) thread carries the same community from self-injury into being made reports and being torn apart.

topics.headline: their own selves are the object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the damage falls first on the very selves whose conditions they wanted improved.
topics.reason: The possessive plural self-object collapses agent and patient and keeps harm internal to the community.

topics.headline: recognized self-damage pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the request as part of a wider self-wronging pattern tied here to rejecting arranged geography.
topics.reason: The local object completes the self-wronging phrase, and 7:160 supplies a provision-misuse parallel.

topics.headline: object identity carries through consequences
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks one community through self-harm, being made reports, and being torn apart by the repeated object pronoun.
topics.reason: The repeated suffix links the harmed selves to the later objects of divine making and tearing.

words.gloss_range: causal-result particle opening the divine consequence clause
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) before the divine result compresses moral cause into outcome. After self-wronging, the next narrative beat is transformation, with no intervening explanation needed.

topics.headline: self-wronging turns into result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a compressed move from moral diagnosis directly into divine transformation.
topics.reason: The prefixed result particle links the wronging clause to the divine making clause without narrating intermediate history.

words.gloss_range: divine making with object suffix and result predicate
words.root_gloss_range: making, placing, assigning, and rendering; here selected as category-changing transformation
words.prose: {{ar:جَعَلْنَٰهُمْ}} ({{tr:jaʿalnāhum}}) renders the same group into a new predicate-state. The verb contains divine agency and the human object together, and its result predicate makes them reports rather than merely leaving reports behind. The making-into-reports formula is sharpened by 23:44 and by the contrast with earlier divine making for them.

topics.headline: made into a new status
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the people are rendered into a new social category: reports.
topics.reason: The verb takes the object suffix plus a result predicate, so the grammar makes narration their transformed state.

topics.headline: divine agent and human object fused
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees divine agency and the same judged community compressed into one transformation word.
topics.reason: The verbal form contains the divine subject and human object, and the prefixed result relation ties it back to self-wronging.

topics.headline: formulaic making into reports
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a known judgment formula specialized here by travel-ingratitude.
topics.reason: The pairing with reports recurs in 23:44, while the local surah contrast turns earlier making for them into making of them.

words.gloss_range: accusative result predicate: reports or narrated materials they become
words.root_gloss_range: occurrence, new event, report, and narration; here report-afterlife is primary
words.prose: {{ar:أَحَادِيثَ}} ({{tr:aḥādītha}}) is what they become: multiple tellable reports. The event-report range makes their collapse both history and narrated evidence, and it reverses the opening speech by turning speakers into material carried by others' speech. This memory conversion comes before the physical tearing is named.

topics.headline: narration is what they become
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that they do not merely leave reports; reports are their new predicate-state.
topics.reason: The accusative broken plural is the result predicate of the making verb and keeps both event and report senses alive.

topics.headline: speech agency reverses into report material
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees speakers turned into passive content in other people's speech.
topics.reason: The reports formula recurs in 23:44, and the local opening speech verb makes the reversal especially sharp.

topics.headline: meaning established before scattering
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah secures their narrative afterlife before naming their physical fragmentation.
topics.reason: The reports predicate comes before the coordinated tearing clause.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction adding a second consequence
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds the tearing as a second coordinated consequence. It keeps memory and dispersal parallel, so the ayah presents social narration and physical fragmentation as two faces of one judgment complex.

topics.headline: memory and dispersal coordinated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that being remembered as reports and being torn apart are parallel outcomes, not one merely explaining the other.
topics.reason: The conjunction attaches the tearing verb as a second coordinated consequence after the reports predicate.

words.gloss_range: completed divine Form II tearing of the same group
words.root_gloss_range: rending, tearing, and scattering; here forceful social-geographic fragmentation is selected

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: same-root torn-state noun following the tearing verb

words.prose: {{ar:مَزَّقْنَٰهُمْ}} ({{tr:mazzaqnāhum}}) describes forceful divine fragmentation of the same group. The Form II tearing makes a once-connected people feel like material ripped apart with ragged, irreparable edges, and the same root returns in {{ar:مُمَزَّقٍ}} ({{tr:mumazzaqin}}) as act and result. The wording also answers the imagined tearing language of 34:7 with narrated historical rupture.

topics.headline: forceful divine fragmentation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the once-connected people treated like material forcefully and raggedly torn, not merely relocated.
topics.reason: The active Form II verb with the object suffix selects divine causation and intensive tearing of the same group.

topics.headline: tearing verb binds to torn result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the act of tearing and the resulting torn state locked together by the repeated root.
topics.reason: The same root appears in the finite verb and the following meem-form result noun.

topics.headline: imagined tearing becomes history
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the surah's earlier imagined tearing in 34:7 return here as narrated divine action and totalized rupture.
topics.reason: The same phrase-family from 34:7 is now used in a historical consequence clause, and the following totality phrase completes the rupture.

words.gloss_range: accusative exhaustive intensifier before the torn-state noun
words.root_gloss_range: totality, entirety, and no-remainder scope; here used to totalize dispersal

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: later genitive totality term governing the qualified reader profile

words.prose: {{ar:كُلَّ}} ({{tr:kulla}}) totalizes the dispersal after the tearing verb. It is not counting separate objects but exhausting every kind or instance of tornness. The same totality word later returns as {{ar:كُلِّ}} ({{tr:kulli}}), shifting from the event's total rupture to every qualified reader who can read it.

topics.headline: every tornness exhausted
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the punishment is totalized as every kind or instance of dispersal, not limited relocation.
topics.reason: The accusative universal before a singular result noun functions as an exhaustive intensifier after the tearing verb.

topics.headline: skeptical phrase becomes historical
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees language from 34:7 move from skeptical resurrection talk into the historical fate of Saba.
topics.reason: The exact phrase recurs from 34:7 to 34:19 with a new narrative function.

topics.headline: total dispersal answered by total readership
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah balancing every dispersal with every qualified reader at the close.
topics.reason: The same totality lexeme reappears later in genitive form inside the audience phrase, shifting from event scope to reception scope.

words.gloss_range: genitive meem-form noun defining the scope of every tornness
words.root_gloss_range: torn state, torn object, or place of tearing; here result-state and dispersal-locus both remain possible
words.prose: {{ar:مُمَزَّقٍ}} ({{tr:mumazzaqin}}) defines the scope of that totality as torn state, instance, or place. The meem-form result noun leaves fragmentation as both condition and destination, and its same-surah tie to 34:7 makes imagined scattering and narrated scattering interpret each other.

topics.headline: result noun defines every tearing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees tornness as condition, instance, and possible place, widening the reach of the dispersal.
topics.reason: The genitive indefinite singular after the universal defines the scope as every kind or instance of torn state.

topics.headline: paired tornness with 34:7
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same tornness phrase links imagined scattering in 34:7 with narrated scattering in 34:19.
topics.reason: The noun carries a same-surah paired-context function because it recurs in the exact totality phrase.

topics.headline: act and outcome leave no gap
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the tearing action close immediately into the torn condition.
topics.reason: The finite verb and meem noun repeat the root as action and result.

words.gloss_range: emphatic clause opener converting the narrative into asserted evidence
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) opens the final interpretive closure. The particle shifts from narrated consequence to asserted evidence, preparing the emphatic sign claim rather than adding another event.

topics.headline: narrative becomes asserted evidence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah stops narrating events and commands the whole chain to be read as evidence.
topics.reason: The emphatic opener begins the final nominal clause and works with the later emphatic particle on the signs predicate.

words.gloss_range: preposition locating the signs inside the preceding chain
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) puts the signs inside the preceding chain. The fronted phrase makes the reader look back into request, wronging, report-making, and tearing before the signs are named.

topics.headline: signs are inside the chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader looks back into the preceding event-chain itself to find the signs, rather than treating signs as an external lesson added afterward.
topics.reason: The fronted prepositional phrase governs the demonstrative and delays the signs noun, making the event-container prominent.

words.gloss_range: distal demonstrative gathering the preceding event-chain
words.prose: {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) compresses the whole reversal into one object of reflection. The distal demonstrative does not point only to the nearest noun; it gathers the multi-clause history as the container of signs.

topics.headline: that gathers the whole reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees request, wronging, report-making, and tearing compressed into one object for reflection.
topics.reason: The distal demonstrative can gather the preceding multi-clause chain under the preposition before signs are named.

words.gloss_range: emphatic particle attached to the signs predicate

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: earlier emphatic clause opener governing the final sign assertion

words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) lands emphasis on the sign predicate. Under {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}), the attached particle makes signhood the fortified claim of the closure.

topics.headline: emphasis lands on signs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the certainty of signhood strengthened at the very point where the signs are named.
topics.reason: The emphatic particle is attached to the plural signs predicate under the earlier emphatic clause opener.

words.gloss_range: indefinite plural signs asserted after a fronted event-container
words.root_gloss_range: sign, indication, and directed evidence; here plural evidentiary signs are selected
words.prose: {{ar:ءَايَٰتٍۢ}} ({{tr:ʾāyātin}}) arrives after the event-container as multiple open-ended signs. The narrative itself points beyond bare events to evidence, and the closing profile makes that evidence real while its reception depends on the patient-grateful reader. The Saba sign-thread expands from 34:15, with 14:5 as a close profile parallel.

topics.headline: multiple signs arrive after the container
topics.reader_payoff: The reader first locates the evidence in the story and then receives it as multiple open-ended signs.
topics.reason: The fronted container delays the indefinite plural predicate, and the emphatic particle makes the plural arrival marked.

topics.headline: history points beyond bare events
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the route history itself become interpretable evidence rather than a bare sequence of events.
topics.reason: The signs are located within the demonstrative event-chain, so the narrative points beyond itself to meaning.

topics.headline: signs require the patient-grateful profile
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that evidence is firmly asserted but its fruitful reception is character-dependent.
topics.reason: The closing pairs signs with the patient-grateful profile, with 14:5 providing a direct parallel and 34:15 showing the Saba sign-thread expanding here.

words.gloss_range: preposition assigning the signs to a qualified receptive class
words.prose: {{ar:لِّ}} ({{tr:li}}) assigns the signs to their functional audience. The preposition marks benefit and special relevance: the signs are asserted, but they are especially for the class defined by endurance and gratitude.

topics.headline: signs assigned to a receptive class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the signs are real, but their functional audience is defined by patience and gratitude.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the following universal profile and marks benefit and special relevance for that class.

words.gloss_range: genitive universal quantifier governing a singular two-trait reader profile
words.root_gloss_range: totality and no-remainder scope; here universalizes every bearer of the qualified type

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: earlier accusative totality term governing the dispersal phrase

words.prose: {{ar:كُلِّ}} ({{tr:kulli}}) opens the audience completely inside a singular character type. Every bearer of the patient-grateful profile is included, while the echo with earlier {{ar:كُلَّ}} ({{tr:kulla}}) shifts totality from dispersal to interpretation. The same sign-reader profile appears in 31:31.

topics.headline: every bearer of the type
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices universal access, but only inside the singular character profile named at the end.
topics.reason: The genitive universal governs singular intensive adjectives, creating a type-description rather than a mass audience.

topics.headline: known sign-reader formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a recurring Quranic profile for reading signs applied here to collapsed travel infrastructure.
topics.reason: The same closing type appears in 31:31, where signs are also assigned to every patient-grateful reader.

topics.headline: every dispersal meets every qualified reader
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices totality shift from the scope of punishment to the scope of qualified interpretation.
topics.reason: The earlier accusative totality governed dispersal, while this genitive totality governs the reader profile.

words.gloss_range: intensive genitive adjective naming habitual endurance in the reader profile
words.root_gloss_range: restraint, endurance, self-binding, and hardness under strain; here habitual endurance is selected
words.prose: {{ar:صَبَّارٍۢ}} ({{tr:ṣabbārin}}) begins the final reader profile with habitual endurance. The intensive pattern makes patience repeated and disciplined, not a one-time wait, and the trait answers the impatience that asked for distance. Its binding, rock-hardness, and bitter-plant imagery make endurance active and costly while the local adjective remains the selected sense.

topics.headline: endurance begins the reader profile
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that endurance and gratitude form one audience profile, with endurance placed first.
topics.reason: The genitive adjective agrees under the universal quantifier and precedes the gratitude adjective.

topics.headline: active costly endurance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees patience as repeated disciplined self-binding under strain, with rock-hardness and bitter-plant imagery making endurance costly while the local adjective remains the selected sense.
topics.reason: The intensive pattern selects habitual endurance; concrete images of binding, hardness, and bitterness are useful pressure but are not separate local senses.

topics.headline: patient reader answers the distance request
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final profile name the opposite habit from the impatience that requested distance.
topics.reason: The trait answers the distance-field locally and joins the sign-reader formula also seen in 14:5.

words.gloss_range: intensive genitive adjective completing the reader profile with habitual gratitude
words.root_gloss_range: gratitude, visible acknowledgment of benefit, and abundant response; here habitual gratitude is selected
words.prose: {{ar:شَكُورٍۢ}} ({{tr:shakūrin}}) completes the profile and seals the ayah on gratitude. The intensive form names habitual visible recognition of benefit, like thriving on scant pasture, answering the failure to receive lordly ordering as provision. The final word links back to the gratitude command in 34:15 and to the mobility-disruption sign profile in 42:33.

topics.headline: gratitude completes the profile
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah lands on gratitude as the final interpretive requirement.
topics.reason: The second genitive adjective agrees with the first under the universal profile and stands as the ayah's final word.

topics.headline: benefit made visible by gratitude
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees gratitude as habitual visible recognition of benefit, with the scant-pasture image supporting that sense without replacing the local adjective.
topics.reason: The intensive pattern selects habitual gratitude; the concrete root image supports visible benefit-response without replacing the local adjective sense.

topics.headline: gratitude answers the failed request
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the missing response to provision named at the very end: the grateful reader remembers blessing rather than turning it into complaint.
topics.reason: The closing trait answers the earlier gratitude command in 34:15, the lordship address in this ayah, and the mobility-disruption parallel in 42:33.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: بَاعِدْ بَيْنَ أَسْفَارِنَا ... وَظَلَمُوا أَنفُسَهُمْ ... وَمَزَّقْنَاهُمْ كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍ
baseline_models.mechanism: The imperative acts on the connective space between journeys. The result scales the requested operation from longer intervals to the rupture of the travelers themselves, while the reflexive object identifies the requesters as both agents and site of loss.

activation_trace.role: Producing distance is the stated operation and supplies the spatial action later intensified into dispersal.
The relation joining endpoints is the object of the request, so the desired gap acts on a connective network.
Journeys and travelers provide the network whose intervals are to be altered.
Putting something outside its proper place or time makes the alteration of useful spacing a self-misplacement.
The self or very entity identifies the petitioners as the object on which their spatial choice returns.
Tearing into separated pieces realizes distance at the scale of the community.

changed_reading.before: They ask for longer journeys and are then punished by dispersal.
changed_reading.after: Their punishment is an ironic enlargement of their own spatial imperative: they ask to loosen the links between routes and become the separated pieces of that request.

baseline_models.mechanism: The verse transfers circulation from persons to discourse. Travelers cease to move as a community, while reports about them circulate and their scattered condition becomes a visible sign.

activation_trace.role: Travel supplies the original bodily and communal mode of circulation.
Making something assume a new state marks the conversion from acting community to narrated object.
Becoming the talk of people gives the destroyed community a second, discursive mobility.
Speech circulating among people links their initiating utterance to the reports that later circulate about them.
The resulting reports and fragments function as outwardly legible marks.

changed_reading.before: They are reduced to cautionary tales after their travel system collapses.
changed_reading.after: Mobility changes medium: the people no longer circulate through routes, but their reports circulate through audiences and expose what their journeys failed to teach.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍ ... لَآيَاتٍ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated totalizer distributes complete fragmentation on one side and receptive readers on the other. Patience retains the scattered evidence without collapse, while gratitude makes little evidence yield a visible effect; together they reconstruct signs from remnants.

activation_trace.role: Material and social pieces supply the dispersed evidence to be read.
Totality links the scope of the tearing with the distributive scope of each qualified reader.
A visible mark is the epistemic product recovered from the fragmentation.
Holding the self back from panic supplies the retention needed to examine dispersed traces.
Making a little input show an effect supplies the capacity to derive significance from scant remains.

changed_reading.before: The ending praises patient and grateful people as morally worthy observers.
changed_reading.after: Patient and grateful name complementary reading operations fitted to the evidence: hold the fragments together long enough for sparse remains to disclose a sign.

context_deltas.mechanism: The whole-surah record and news cues make the focus conversion into reports more than proverbial extinction. Written ordering and transmitted news recollect dispersed units in a legible medium, so physical scattering is accompanied by semiotic preservation.

activation_trace.role: Ordered writing supplies a medium in which even the smallest dispersed item remains legible.
Delivered news makes total tearing reportable before the focus turns the torn people themselves into reports.
Becoming people's talk is the focus transformation from embodied actors to transmissible memory.
Separated pieces create the material loss that narrative ordering partially counters.
The preserved account is not neutral storage but a mark available for recognition.

structural_cues: 34:3 places every smaller and larger item in a clear book.
34:7 packages total tearing as news; 34:19 then sequences becoming reports, tearing, and signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies comprehensive inscription, delivered news, and the focus sequence from reports to fragments to signs. I infer that discourse recomposes what material dispersal separates; the live alternative is that أَحَادِيثَ marks only proverbial extinction, not preservation.

changed_reading.before: Their material disappearance leaves only a loose cautionary memory.
changed_reading.after: Their agency disappears, but their trace is actively reordered into report and sign; fragmentation changes the medium of presence rather than erasing every record.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same total-tearing formula first appears as the scoffed condition for new creation, and the surah later gathers everyone. Its application to the petitioners is therefore an ironic reversal: those who mocked reconstitution undergo disassembly, but disassembly is not granted the status of final nonbeing.

activation_trace.role: The exact tearing image appears before the focus as the imagined reduction of bodies to pieces.
Creative bringing-into-being places reconstitution on the far side of the tearing formula.
New occurrence after cutting makes renewal, not nullity, the explicit sequel imagined for torn matter.
The focus applies the previously mocked condition to the social body of the mockers.
Driving and collecting a group supplies the later reversal of dispersion.
Joining what was dispersed explicitly denies that tearing escapes eventual collection.

structural_cues: 34:7 and 34:19 repeat مُزِّقْتُمْ/مَزَّقْنَاهُمْ with كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍ.
34:7 places new creation after tearing, while 34:40 gathers them all.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact lexical reprise, the sequence tearing to new creation, and later universal gathering. I infer deliberate reversal of the earlier mockery; the live alternative is that the shared phrase is only a conventional totalizing idiom.

changed_reading.before: Every tearing denotes terminal destruction of the community.
changed_reading.after: It denotes punitive disassembly and loss of communal form, while the surrounding creation and gathering cues keep it from meaning ontological erasure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured linkage first produces complete protective mail and then a secure route through linked settlements. The focus request asks to enlarge the intervals in that second mesh; the ensuing tearing reads as what happens when a protective network is over-spaced until its links no longer hold.

activation_trace.role: Completeness names the protective whole produced by correctly linked parts.
Fitting a thing to its proper measure supplies the calibration of the linked construction.
Piercing and binding rings or leather supplies the material image of discrete nodes held into one mesh.
Settlements gather people into route nodes rather than leaving them as isolated points.
Deliberate estimation governs the spacing of travel just as measure governed the earlier linked craft.
Security is the functional protection delivered by the measured route mesh.
The connective relation between nodes is precisely what the petition asks to stretch.
Tearing renders the social result of links pulled beyond continuity.

structural_cues: 34:11 says to measure within linked construction; 34:18 repeats the same measuring root over travel.
34:18 places visible villages between endpoints and states the resulting night-and-day security.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured chain linkage, measured travel, intervening settlements, security, and final tearing. I infer a material analogy in which route stations behave like correctly spaced rings; the live alternative is that the armor craft and route system are independent examples of measure.

changed_reading.before: They reject a convenient itinerary and are dispersed when it disappears.
changed_reading.after: They reject protective connectivity itself: demanding larger gaps pulls apart a calibrated social mesh until travelers, not merely routes, become disconnected units.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context repeatedly binds gratitude to enacted use of provision, rarity, proper measure, safety, and the alternation of expansion with restriction. The focus shakur is therefore the person able to recognize sufficiency at a small or measured scale, exactly the capacity absent from a community that treats near, safe intervals as deprivation.

activation_trace.role: Intended action makes gratitude a practiced response rather than verbal appreciation alone.
Acknowledging a benefit and its giver is commanded as work and identified as rare.
Fewness marks the scarcity of people who perform that recognition.
Allocated provision identifies the gardens and route economy as gifts to be received, not defects to outgrow.
Properly fitted measure frames short travel intervals as calibrated sufficiency.
Settled security is the benefit made available by that measure.
Expansion and abundance supply one pole of the surah's provision scale.
Constriction to a small measure supplies the other pole without making measure itself a negation of provision.
The one for whom little suffices and visibly bears fruit is equipped to read measured nearness as benefit.

structural_cues: 34:13 commands gratitude as work and immediately says the grateful are few.
34:15 joins provision and gratitude; 34:18 joins measured travel and safety; 34:36 joins expanded provision and constriction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gratitude-as-work, fewness, provision, measured safe travel, and expansion versus constriction. I infer that the petition misreads calibrated sufficiency as lack; a live alternative is that the demand seeks prestige or isolation rather than more provision.

changed_reading.before: Patient and grateful are general virtues appended to the disaster.
changed_reading.after: Shakur names scale literacy: the ability to let a modest, near, measured gift register as abundance, while the petitioners destroy the gift by demanding distance as its opposite.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequel denies coercive authority and describes voluntary following that separates out a group; the later self-directed straying formula closes the causal loop. The focus's self-wronging therefore names operative consent, not merely the destination of punishment.

activation_trace.role: Misplacing the arrangement is attributed to the petitioners themselves.
Their very selves are the surface on which their chosen distortion takes effect.
Following behind supplies the voluntary behavioral path that realizes the prior supposition.
A distinct group remaining outside the following shows differentiation rather than uniform compulsion.
The explicit absence of overpowering force removes coercion as the causal engine.
Straying from the intended course supplies a remote verbal parallel for directional error.
Straying returns upon the very self, restating the focus's reflexive causal geometry.

structural_cues: 34:20 follows the focus with their following except for one group.
34:21 denies any coercive power; 34:50 says straying is against one's own self.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies following without overpowering authority, a separated exception, and a later self-directed straying formula. I infer that their spoken request is an efficacious consent to the pattern that harms them; the live alternative is that the Iblis passage broadens beyond Saba and should not specify their motive.

changed_reading.before: They wrong themselves in the generic moral sense and then receive an external catastrophe.
changed_reading.after: Their words and following choices author the topology of their loss; the catastrophe realizes an uncoerced directional error that folds back onto the self.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence opposes nearness to failed escape, reaching from afar, and a barrier between persons and desire. It retrospectively converts the focus petition from a preference about travel into the geometry of terminal inaccessibility: distance is attractive only until something necessary must be reached.

activation_trace.role: The petition positively asks for produced remoteness.
It asks that the relation connecting endpoints be altered by that remoteness.
Divine nearness supplies the rejected spatial alternative to remoteness.
Failure to escape or attain turns spatial arrangement into irreversible missed access.
Reaching by extension names the action that can no longer succeed from afar.
The focus root returns at a distant place where desired belief is no longer reachable.
An intervening barrier makes separation an active obstruction rather than neutral space.
The focus construction returns to locate the imposed separation between persons and their object.
The soul's pull toward what it wants identifies the necessary object now blocked by distance.

structural_cues: 34:50-52 moves from a near Lord and seizure from a near place to impossible reaching from a distant place.
34:54 repeats حِيلَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ and places desire across the barrier.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a closing near/distant contrast, failed reaching, and the repeated between-them-and construction. I infer that this finale retrospectively realizes the focus request's spatial logic; the live alternative is that the closing distance concerns delayed belief independently of Saba's travel petition.

changed_reading.before: Their wish for farther journeys is answered by geographic dispersion.
changed_reading.after: They choose distance as a good and discover its hidden cost: the requested gap matures into inability to reach belief or desire when access becomes urgent.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the destruction-or-curse branch of ب ع د inside an imperative whose ordinary force is spatial. It remains anchored in بَاعِدْ and is supported by the immediate self-wronging and tearing results, but downstream prose should present it as secondary wordplay, not replace 'make distant' with 'destroy.'

activation_trace.role: Address to the sovereign gives the spoken imperative the force of an invoked disposition.
Distance shading into destruction or curse lets the requested verb carry an exploratory self-dooming overtone.
Self-misplacement keeps the overtone causally attached to the petitioners rather than making it an unrelated pun.
The resulting rupture supplies the visible realization that makes the destructive branch worth carrying.

changed_reading.before: They innocently phrase a bad request whose danger appears only in the answer.
changed_reading.after: Their imperative may already contain a branch-shadow of its answer, so the petition sounds like an unwitting self-curse enacted by the ensuing rupture.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant ق و ل to ق ل ل mapping for قَالُوا, not the lexical meaning of the verb. It remains packet-anchored and gains sequence support from 'few' in 34:13 and diminished produce in 34:16; downstream prose should label it a branch or sound-pattern activation, never translate قَالُوا as scarcity.

activation_trace.role: The split-root scarcity image makes their speech an exploratory formal hinge from abundance toward lack.
Fewness first qualifies the grateful, placing scarcity beside the response the focus later requires.
Little produce then makes scarcity a material result inside the Saba sequence.
The ability to thrive on little supplies the countercapacity that their scarcity-producing speech lacks.

changed_reading.before: They speak after abundance has already diminished.
changed_reading.after: At an exploratory formal level, their saying becomes the hinge that completes the move from rare gratitude to material little, as though the demand for more distance manufactures the scarcity it cannot appreciate.

strongest_changes: The request for farther journeys becomes a self-authored topology: calibrated links are over-spaced until the people themselves are dispersed.
The exact tearing formula is framed by new creation and later gathering, so total fragmentation is punitive reversal rather than final nonbeing.
The surah's close turns desired distance into failed reach and a barrier from desire.
Ṣabbār and shakūr become capacities for retaining scattered evidence and recognizing measured sufficiency, not only generic virtues.
summary.what_was_special: Repeated measures and spatial relations did the most work: q-d-r links protective craft, routes, and provision; b-y-n and b-ʿ-d link social connectivity to final reachability; the packet's q-w-l to q-l-l split exposed a contained scarcity wordplay.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the measured chain-mail construction is intended to model the route network or merely parallels its vocabulary.
Whether the exact tearing formula in 34:7 and 34:19 signals deliberate reversal beyond a shared totalizing idiom.
How much weight the non-dominant q-w-l to q-l-l mapping can bear without exceeding a deliberately exploratory sound-pattern activation.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Requested distance converts route into rupture.** `ب ع د/B003` is creating separation, `س ف ر/B003` journeying, `ح د ث/B004` becoming a tale people tell, and `م ز ق/B001` tearing into pieces. The request expands the measured intervals of 34:18; the response moves from living travelers to circulated stories and scattered bodies. Distance is the control they alter, rupture its spatial output, and tale its social afterlife. The packet gives request and result; I infer that removing relays turns traversable distance into fragmentation. The ayah reads their speech as a demand to dismantle the network that made travel safe.
2. **Patience and gratitude are counter-skills for continuity.** `ص ب ر/B001` is restraint from panic and `ش ك ر/B001` acknowledgment of favor. Their paired close assigns endurance to disrupted intervals and gratitude to the infrastructure previously overlooked. I infer that these dispositions preserve recognition across scarcity and abundance. The sign is visible to those who can hold and acknowledge, not merely observe.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 34:31-33 turned living speakers into a blame-exchange, unexpectedly fulfilling the “tales” mechanism before the final judgment and showing how fragmentation persists in speech.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Distance converts a lived route into scattered report.** `ب ع د B003` supplies creating distance, `س ف ر B001` uncovering and clearing as well as `س ف ر B003` journeying, `م ز ق B001` tearing into pieces, and `ح د ث B004` becoming a tale people tell. The request reverses the close waystation network of 34:18; movement then becomes fragmentation, and inhabitants become reports. The branches assign distance the severing role and tales the residual social form. The packet supplies the sequence; I infer that broken mobility leaves only circulated traces. `فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ` reads as the afterlife of a dismantled network, not a separate rhetorical flourish.

2. **Patient gratitude preserves connection.** `ص ب ر B001` supplies self-restraint from panic and `ش ك ر B002` being sustained by little. These qualities close a narrative in which impatience with closely spaced travel asks for greater distance and abundance is not recognized. The branches assign restraint and low-input responsiveness the role of resisting that destructive request. The packet gives behavior and outcome; I infer the preventive relation. The closing pair reads as a compact maintenance ethic for networks under ordinary limits.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 34:20's following and 34:21's denial of coercive authority corrected a purely infrastructural account of the scattering. The broken network is also an enacted choice-pattern: an expectation becomes true through stepwise following, not through irresistible outside force.

lexicalization_scope.note: Temel azlık anlamı ile yoksullaşma ve az görme gibi türemiş biçimler birlikte bulunur; yokluk ve seyrekleşme anlamları ise yalnızca belirtilen yapılara bağlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin sayı, miktar ya da ölçü bakımından çok olmayışını bildirir. Bundan yoksulluk ve düşüklük, bir şeyi az sayma veya az gösterme ve belirli yapılarda hiçlik ya da seyrek gerçekleşme anlamları gelişir.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın sayı, miktar veya ölçü bakımından çok olmayışıdır.
Azlık, kişinin yoksullaşması veya toplum içinde düşük ve değersiz görülmesi sonucuna uzanabilir.
Bir şeyi gerçekte ya da değerlendiren kişinin gözünde az sayma ve az gösterme anlamını taşır.
Belirli olumsuzluk ve sıklık yapılarında hiç yokluğu veya bir eylemin pek seyrek gerçekleşmesini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar azlığın temel sayı ve miktar karşıtlığında birleşir; yoksulluk ve düşüklük, az sayma ve bazı yapılarda yokluğa yaklaşan kullanım bu çekirdeğin düzenli uzantılarıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyin en üstünü veya başını çekirdek anlam olarak verir; dağın yuvarlak üst bölümü, insan başı ve kılıcın başındaki topuz bu çekirdeğin açık uzmanlaşmalarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol uzamsal başı ve en üst parçayı bildirir; sayısal azlık ya da büyük kap anlamını içermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel baş ve en üst bölüm anlamı ile dağ tepesi, insan başı ve kılıç topuzu gibi yapıya bağlı uzmanlaşmalar ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin başını veya en üst bölümünü bildirir. Dağın üstteki yuvarlak parçası, insan başı ve kılıcın sap ucundaki topuz bu uzamsal çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir nesnenin veya oluşumun başı ya da en üstte bulunan bölümüdür.
Dağın en üstünde yer alan, kimi tanımda yuvarlak biçimli bölümünü adlandırır.
İnsan başı ile kılıcın sap ucundaki başlık veya topuz da aynı üst ve baş kavramıyla adlandırılır.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol büyük bir kap türünü ve onun ölçü değerini kapsar; nicelik azlığı veya dağ tepesi anlamını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Büyük küp anlamı çekirdektir; belirli bir bölgeye bağlanan kap adı ile iki kaplık ölçü yalnızca kendi yapılardaki uzmanlaşmalardır.

concept_map.definition: Büyük bir küpü veya küpe benzeyen iri kabı bildirir. Belirli bir bölgenin iri küpleri ve iki böyle kabın aldığı miktar bu kap anlamına bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Küpe benzeyen, özellikle sıvı taşımaya veya saklamaya elverişli büyük bir kaptır.
Belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler veya büyük toprak kaplar bu adın tanınmış bir türünü oluşturur.
İki büyük kap, bu iki kabın kendisini veya onların aldığı sıvı miktarını bildiren bir ölçü değeri kazanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar iri bir küp veya büyük kap üzerinde birleşir; tanınmış bölgesel kaplar büyüklüğü örnekler, iki kaplık kullanım ise nesne adını kapasite ölçüsüne taşır.

Bir öznenin aşağıdaki konumundan yükselmesi veya kuş gibi harekete ve uçuşa başlamasıdır.
Yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlamasıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişiyi korku veya öfke yüzünden tutan titreme ve silkinişi açıkça tanımlar; genel hareket kararsızlığı değil, duygusal tetikleyicisi bulunan bedensel bir sarsıntı söz konusudur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol insanda korku veya öfkeyle beliren titremeyle sınırlıdır; nesnelerin genel sallanma ve yerinde duramama hali ayrı koldadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Duygudan doğan titreme temel addır; kişiyi titremenin tutması ve öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi yalnızca ilgili yapılara bağlı anlatımlardır.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın korku veya öfke yüzünden titremesi, ürpermesi ya da bedensel olarak silkelenmesidir. Durum, kişiyi bir titreme nöbetinin tutması veya öfkenin titremeyle dışa vurulması biçiminde anlatılabilir.

facets.statement: İnsan bedeninde beliren titreme, ürperti veya istemsiz silkiniş halidir.
Titremenin belirleyici nedeni korku ya da öfkedir.
Belirli yapılarda titremenin kişiyi tutması veya kişinin öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar insandaki titreme ve silkinişte birleşir; korku ile öfke başlıca nedenlerdir ve durum hem kişiyi tutan bir nöbet hem öfkenin bedensel belirtisi olarak anlatılır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Duygusal nedeni ve bedensel titremeyi birlikte taşıyan bütün kol için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Korku veya öfke koşulunu ve bunun doğurduğu bedensel titremeyi birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Korkunun yol açtığı kısa ve istemsiz bedensel titreme bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Korkuya bağlı istemsiz titreme ve silkiniş hissini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Titremenin kişiyi birden tutan belirgin bir durum olarak anlatıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Titremenin kişiyi tutan bedensel bir olay olarak sunuluşunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Öfkenin bedensel titreme halinde dışa vurulduğu kişi bağlamlarına özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Öfke nedenini ve onunla birlikte ortaya çıkan titremeyi korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol titremenin korku veya öfkeden doğmasını anlam sınırının parçası yapar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol insandaki titreme veya silkinişi belirli bir duygusal nedenle sınırlamaz.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da insan bedeninde ortaya çıkan titreme veya silkinişi adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bedensel olay aynıdır; bu kol korku ve öfke koşulunu taşırken komşu kart neden bakımından daha genel kalır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol korkunun yanında öfkeyi de titremenin belirleyici nedeni olarak içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol hastalık, gevşeklik, yumuşaklık ve korkaklıkla ilişkili titremeleri de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da özellikle korku sırasında insanda görülen titreme ve ürpermede örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Korkuya bağlı kullanımda yakınlaşırlar; bu kol öfkeyi ekler, komşu kol ise hastalık ve bedensel gevşeklik gibi başka nedenlere açılır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; genel insan titremesi ve nedenleri daha geniş ürperme alanı, bu kolun kişi ve duygu sınırını en iyi gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi hareket ettirip sallandırma, nesnenin bulunduğu yerde kararlı duramaması ve hareketin çıkardığı sesi birlikte verir; bunlar tek bir fiziksel hareket olayının neden, sonuç ve işitsel yönleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol genel fiziksel oynama, kararsızlık ve hareket sesiyle ilgilidir; korku veya öfkeden doğan insana özgü titreme değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak kolun hareket ettirme, sallanma, yerinde duramama ve hareket sesi anlamlarını kapsar; özel bir yapının anlamı genelleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi hareket ettirerek yerinden oynatmayı ve onun kararsızca sallanıp bulunduğu yerde duramamasını bildirir; bu hareketin çıkardığı ses de aynı olayın işitsel yönüdür.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi hareket ettirip onun yerinden oynamasına ve sarsılmasına neden olmaktır.
Nesnenin bulunduğu yerde sabit kalmayıp sallanması, oynaması veya düzensiz hareket etmesidir.
Sallanma ve yer değiştirme sırasında çıkan ses, hareket olayının işitsel belirtisi olarak adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar dışarıdan hareket ettirme ile nesnenin kararsızca sallanıp yerinde duramaması üzerinde birleşir; hareketin sesi bu fiziksel olayın ayrılmaz işitsel belirtisi olarak eklenir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Neden olunan hareketi ve nesnenin ortaya çıkan kararsız sallanmasını birlikte kapsayan temel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Hareket ettirme nedenini ve sabit kalamayan nesnenin sallanma sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin bir nesneyi hareket ettirerek onun oynamasına ve sarsılmasına neden olduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dışarıdan uygulanan hareketi ve nesnenin sarsılması sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesnenin gevşeklik veya kararsızlık nedeniyle bulunduğu yerde sabit kalmadığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sabit kalamama ile düzensiz sallanma durumunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sallanan veya oynayan nesnenin çıkardığı sesin adlandırıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sesin genel bir ses değil, hareketten doğan işitsel belirti oluşunu korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: sallanma, yerinde duramama ve hareket sesi

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da bir nesneyi hareket ettirip onun sallanmasına veya sarsılmasına neden olmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Fiziksel sarsılma alanı yakındır; bu kol hareket ettirme, sabit kalamama ve hareket sesini kurarken komşu kol farklı varlıklardaki şiddetli sarsıntıyı öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da bir nesnenin hareketi sırasında ortaya çıkan işitilebilir sesi içerebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kolun çekirdeği fiziksel kararsızlık ve sallanmadır, ses ikincildir; komşu kolda ses ve çınlama daha bağımsız bir anlam alanı oluşturur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol nesnenin oynatılması, yerinde duramaması ve hareket sesiyle ilgilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol insanda korku veya öfke yüzünden ortaya çıkan titremeyi bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da gözle görülen düzensiz bir sarsılma veya titreme görünümü taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kolda nesne ve fiziksel kararsızlık kurucudur; komşu kolda insan bedeni ile korku veya öfke nedeni kurucudur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, sahiplik, buyruk yetkisi, yönetim ve düzenleme çekirdeğini destekler. Bununla birlikte yalın ve mutlak kullanım Tanrı'ya özgüdür; insanlar ve nesneler için anlam, sahip olunan ya da yönetilen şeyin belirtilmesine bağlıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Tanrı'ya özgü mutlak kullanım ile bir şeyin sahibi ya da yöneticisi olmayı bildiren tamlamalı kullanım ayrı tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçim ile ev, hayvan veya başka bir şey üzerinden kurulan tamlamalar aynı kapsamda değildir; tanım bu kullanım koşulunu korur.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlık ya da şey üzerinde sahiplik, üstün yetke ve düzenleyici yönetim kurma niteliğidir. Mutlak kullanım Tanrı'yı gösterirken başka kullanımlar yönetilen veya sahip olunan şeyi açıkça belirtir.

facets.statement: Sahiplik, buyruk yetkisi ve yönetip düzenleme aynı çekirdekte birleşir.
Mutlak adlandırma Tanrı'ya özgüdür; insan için kullanım belirtilmiş bir şeye bağlıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar sahip, buyruğu geçen yönetici, düzenleyici ve Tanrı anlamlarını ortak bir üstün yetke ilişkisi çevresinde toplar; mutlak kullanımın sınırını ayrıca belirtir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sahiplik ile düzenleyici yetkenin birlikte anlatıldığı genel kavramsal bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sahiplik, üstün yetke ve yönetim çekirdeğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Adın hiçbir bağlı unsur olmadan mutlak kullanıldığı inanç bağlamına özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Mutlak kullanımın yalnız Tanrı'yı göstermesi sınırını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ev, hayvan veya başka bir varlık üzerinde sahiplik ve yönetim bildiren tamlamalarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Belirtilen şey üzerindeki sahiplik ve yönetim ilişkisini korur.

error_profile.loses: Sahiplik, düzenleme ve Tanrı'ya özgü mutlak kullanım ayrımını kaybeder.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Örtüşme sahiplik ve üstünlük alanındadır; odak dal kullanımın mutlak ya da tamlamalı oluşunu ve düzenleyici yönetimi sınırlar, komşu dal ise tapınma nesnesine ve yükselme çağrışımına da açılır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الرب بمعنى الله تعالى، ومالك الشيء، وسيده المطاع، وصاحبه، ورب الدار والدابة والملك

branches.source_phrase_ar: الرب: الله تبارك وتعالى؛ ورب كل شيء مالكه (jamhara); رب كل شئ: مالكه؛ وقد قالوه في الجاهلية للملك؛ رببت القوم: سستهم (sihah); يكون الرب: المالك؛ ويكون الرب: السيد المطاع؛ ويكون الرب: المصلح (tahdhib); الرب مصدر مستعار للفاعل؛ لا يقال الرب مطلقا إلا لله؛ رب الدار ورب الفرس (mufradat); فالرب المالك والخالق والصاحب؛ والله جل ثناؤه الرب (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, bir şeyi gözeterek düzeltme, geliştirme ve aşama aşama tamamlanmış duruma getirme sürecini tutarlı biçimde gösterir. Çocuk yetiştirme, mülkü iyileştirme ve yapılan iyiliği tamamlama bu sürecin farklı nesneleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız bakım göstermeyi değil, gözetilen şeyi zaman içinde düzeltip tamamlamayı gerektirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Eylemin yalın gelişim çekirdeği ile çocuk, mülk ve yapılan iyilik gibi nesnelere bağlı kullanımları ayrıştırılarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi sürekli gözetim altında düzeltmek, geliştirmek ve aşama aşama tamamlanmış durumuna ulaştırmaktır.

facets.statement: Süreç, gözetilen şeyi eksik durumdan tamamlanmış duruma doğru geliştirir.
Çocuk yetiştirme, bir mülkü iyileştirme ve yapılan iyiliği tamamlama başlıca uygulamalardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar düzeltme, sürekli bakım, yetiştirme ve tamamlama öğelerini tek bir aşamalı gelişim sürecinde birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bakımın gelişme, düzeltme ve tamamlanma sonucuna yöneldiği bütün genel bağlamlarda kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Aşamalı gelişim, bakım, düzeltme ve tamamlanma öğelerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir çocuğun veya canlı varlığın gelişimini üstlenme bağlamında doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Sürekli bakım yoluyla gelişip olgunlaştırma sürecini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Mülk, iş veya yapılan iyilik gibi bir nesneyi eksiksiz duruma getirme bağlamında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Düzeltme ve tamamlanmış duruma ulaştırma sonucunu korur.
